headline: Committee edits South Maui plan history and housing policies

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.voteItem: Amendment on the 10-year community plan update requirement
meeting.summary: The committee kept editing the South Maui Community Plan, switching a moku name to Wailuku and approving affordable housing policy changes.
meeting.recap: The committee continued its review of Bill 108, the South Maui Community Plan update.[[0:06:40]] Members voted 7–0 to say the charter requires community plans to be updated every 10 years.[[0:46:23]] In a 6–1 roll call vote, members removed a foreign explorer's name for a bay from the plan.[[1:38:52]] Members voted 7–0 to add history on the 1893 overthrow and the 1905 creation of Maui County.[[1:53:45]] Members approved studying a County parcel by the Kīhei Police Station for uses including affordable housing.[[3:09:03]] Members approved a policy encouraging affordable and workforce housing across South Maui sub-areas 1 through 5.[[3:11:08]] Members approved a policy encouraging housing preference programs to prioritize current South Maui residents and workers.[[3:11:57]] The chair said this differed from a specific wildfire data action adopted the day before.[[3:15:27]] Several members said they prefer that specific wording.[[3:18:35]] Plan discussion will continue on October 21 and November 18.[[3:32:26]] A draft must be ready by December 2 to send to the next council.[[3:32:42]] The committee deferred the item.[[3:39:25]]
decided: Members approved replacing 'may' with 'required' for 10-year plan updates per the charter.
Members approved saying the population increase on page 24 is over the 20-year plan timeframe.
Members approved striking the last paragraph on page 11.
Members approved replacing 'Great Māhele' with 'Māhele' throughout.
Members approved replacing 'capabilities' with 'effects' on page 16.
Members approved replacing the first two paragraphs on page 19 with part three of Granicus item 46.
Members approved striking the word 'exemplary' on page 21.
Members approved the South Maui Today changes, including changing 'region' to 'area' there.
Members approved changing 'U.S. mainland' to 'U.S. continent.'.
Members amended policy 2.2.26 to encourage preference programs to prioritize current South Maui residents and workers.
meeting.next: The gulch discussion will be revisited when Public Works can attend. A department director said his department will add the discussed definitions to Appendix E.

boards.name: Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

issues.oneLine: The committee rewrote affordable and workforce housing policies in the South Maui Community Plan.
issues.why: A community advisory group member said affordable housing should also be near amenities, not placed far from the attractive parts of town.
issues.brief: Members approved studying a County parcel by the Kīhei Police Station for uses including affordable housing.[[#1]] A new policy encourages affordable and workforce housing to be spread across sub-areas 1 through 5.[[#2]] Policy 2.2.26 now encourages preference programs to prioritize current South Maui residents and workers.[[#3]]

issues.oneLine: Members discussed an action to build a data map of past South Maui wildfires.
issues.why: A member said the data would let the community check recommendations without relying only on whoever holds a position.
issues.brief: The adopted action calls for data on the acreage, year, location, and cause of South Maui wildfires.[[#1]] A member said South Maui also had a fire on August 8, 2023.[[#2]]
